description: The single elevated headline card for the Unbudgeted Spending screen. Leads with the total unbudgeted amount this month and a color-independent status line stating how many categories lack a budget.

grandTotal.description: Sum of all group totals this month, in dollars. Format with formatCurrency/fmt.

categoryCount.description: Number of parent-category groups with unbudgeted spending (groups.length).

stateNotes.loading: Rendered as Skeleton placeholders: hero 140x28, subtitle 180x12, status line 220x12 (see spec 3.2).
stateNotes.hidden: Not rendered when categoryCount === 0; the empty state replaces the entire body.

statusLine.text: {categoryCount} categor{y|ies} have spending but no budget

accessibility.label: Unbudgeted this month, {formatCurrency(grandTotal)}. {categoryCount} categories have spending but no budget.
accessibility.colorIndependent: Status conveyed by alert-circle icon + word 'no budget' + warning color together, never color alone.
